nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $r \ge 1$ a natural number, and $K$ a finite field of characteristic $p$ with $q = p^r$ elements. A formal power series $f = \sum_n f_n X^n \in K[[X]]$ is algebraic over the polynomial ring $K[X]$ (it is a root of a nonzero polynomial with coefficients in $K[X]$) if and only if its coefficient sequence $n \mapsto f_n$ is $p$-automatic in the sense of finite automata with output.
nodes.title: Christol's theorem, automaton form

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $r \ge 1$ a natural number, and $K$ a finite field of characteristic $p$ with $q = p^r$ elements. A formal power series $f = \sum_n f_n X^n \in K[[X]]$ is algebraic over the polynomial ring $K[X]$ (it is a root of a nonzero polynomial with coefficients in $K[X]$) if and only if its coefficient sequence $n \mapsto f_n$ is $p$-automatic, that is, its $p$-kernel is finite.

conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
